title: Number Slider
description: A challenging 4x4 sliding puzzle game where you move tiles to arrange numbers in order.
how_to_play:
1. Press Enter to start the game.
2. Use arrow keys to move tiles into the empty space.
3. Arrange all numbers in order from 1 to 15.
4. Your score is based on how few moves you take.

Tips:
- Plan ahead to avoid unnecessary moves.
- Focus on completing one row at a time.
- Keep track of the empty space to optimize moves.
